'''Konecta''' is a Spanish [[multinational corporation|multinational]] services and technology company based in [[Madrid]].

==History==
Konecta was founded in [[Spain]] in 1999 by José María Pacheco.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://elpais.com/diario/2004/03/28/negocio/1080482609_850215.html|title=La irresistible ascensión de Konecta|first=Carlos|last=Gómez|date=March 28, 2004|via=elpais.com}}</ref> [[Banco Santander]] was both a client of the company and a shareholder, for which Konecta provided [[call centre|call center]] services.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://cincodias.elpais.com/cincodias/2022/04/06/companias/1649260980_214122.html|title=Konecta se fusiona con Comdata y crean un gigante del 'call center'|first=Marimar Jiménez, Álvaro|last=Bayón|date=April 6, 2022|website=Cinco Días}}</ref> In 2015, [[PAI Partners]] invested in Konecta, becoming a shareholder alongside Banco Santander and Pacheco.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cincodias.elpais.com/cincodias/2019/02/05/companias/1549366452_551351.html|title=Santander y PAI Partners venden Konecta a la cúpula directiva y el fondo ICG|first=Santiago Millán|last=Alonso|date=February 5, 2019|website=Cinco Días}}</ref>

In February 2019, Banco Santander and PAI Partners agreed to sell Konecta to [[Intermediate Capital Group]], together with Pacheco and the management team.
In April 2022, Konecta and the Italian [[outsourcing]] group Comdata agreed to [[mergers and acquisitions|merge]], creating one of the largest [[customer experience|CX]] [[business process outsourcing|BPO]] groups globally. The combined group unified its operations under the Konecta name in 2023.<ref name="auto"/>

In April 2024, [[Nourdine Bihmane]], formerly [[chief executive officer|chief executive]] of [[Atos]], was appointed group CEO.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eleconomista.es/actualidad/noticias/12762629/04/24/konecta-ficha-a-nourdine-bihmane-ex-atos-como-nuevo-ceo.html|title=Konecta ficha a  Nourdine Bihmane (ex ATOS) como nuevo CEO|date=April 10, 2024}}</ref>

In 2025, Konecta launched a three-year transformation plan, Katalyst 2028, focused on [[artificial intelligence|AI]] and digital services.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://emprendedores.es/casos-de-exito/konecta-financiacion/|title=Konecta asegura 150 millones de financiación para su plan Katalyst 2028|website=Emprendedores}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.expansion.com/empresas/2025/02/14/67ae4f19468aebe9628b4583.html|title=Konecta logra 150 millones de JPMorgan e ICG para crecer en IA|first=Pepe|last=Bravo|date=February 13, 2025|website=EXPANSION}}</ref>

==Operations==
Konecta provides outsourced [[customer experience]] (CX) and customer management services, as well as consulting and technology-enabled business services. Following its merger with Comdata, the company expanded its operations across Europe and the [[Middle East]]. In 2025, Konecta acquired Speak33 in France and Sales Performance in Italy.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://en-contact.com/konecta-steps-up-digital-marketing-with-two-acquisitions-in-france-and-italy|title=Konecta steps up digital marketing with two acquisitions in France and Italy|website=En-contact}}</ref>

==Controversies==
In July 2012, Konecta reported that employees participating in a [[strike action|strike]] in [[Chile]] had engaged in actions such as blocking infrastructure, threatening staff, and damaging company property. [[Trade union|Trade unions]] disputed these claims and described the strike as lawful.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.meganoticias.cl/nacional/konecta-acusa-practicas-delictuales-de-trabajadores-en-huelga-legal.html|title=Konecta acusa ''prácticas delictuales'' de trabajadores en huelga legal|date=July 10, 2012|website=meganoticias.cl}}</ref>

In August 2022, four employees at Konecta's [[Avilés]] center in [[Asturias]], Spain, were dismissed on performance grounds. The union Corriente Sindical de Izquierda (CSI) criticized the dismissals, arguing that they were unjustified and linked to labor conditions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lne.es/aviles/2022/08/04/csi-condena-despido-injustificado-cuatro-73055223.html|title=La CSI condena el despido 'injustificado' de cuatro empleadas de Konecta|first=F. L.|last=J|date=August 4, 2022|website=La Nueva España}}</ref>
